notes.title: Version 1.02 – The One with the Steam Trading Cards
notes.notes:
Retool now has Steam Trading cards! Apart from that big change, the rest are quite small. They can be seen below. As always, let us know if you have any issues with this build of the game.

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
    [*]Optimized game
    [*]Updated main menu
    [*]Minor tweaks on levels
[/list]

We also want to let you know that we have put an indefinite hold on the training/tutorial levels. Our plan is to start working on them again once we have the Xbox One version of the game completed and there is still a demand for them.
